title: pillbox.session-packet/1 manifest (packet.json)
description: The manifest stored as the first entry, packet.json, of a pillbox session packet. The packet is one deterministic POSIX ustar archive (pax headers only for long paths): packet.json, then every entry below in this order, under workspace/ and harness/. Written and read only by `pillbox checkpoint pack|unpack`; docs/session-packet.md specifies the tar layout, the credential exclusions and the size limits. Every object is closed and an absent optional field is omitted, never null. The packet digest is sha256: plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the whole tar.

harness.description: The harness whose state is under harness/, e.g. claude_code.

harness_session_id.description: The harness's own session id, e.g. Claude Code's session UUID.

transcript.description: Path of the harness transcript, relative to harness/. Must name a file entry.

entries.description: Every directory, regular file and symlink in the two trees, sorted by path in byte order with no duplicates. Each entry's parent is a tree root or an earlier dir entry.

entry_path.description: workspace/... or harness/...: slash-separated, with no empty, . or .. component.

file.description: A regular file; unpacked with mode 0755 when executable, else 0644.

symlink.description: A symlink. The target is relative and resolves inside the link's own tree without passing through another symlink in the packet; pack refuses any other link.
